guides.title: 晶圓薄化與背面研磨：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Wafer thinning and backside grinding: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 背磨厚度與次表面損傷要分開管理。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Control remaining thickness separately from subsurface damage. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：背磨厚度與次表面損傷要分開管理。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：需要厚度圖、邊緣缺口檢查及強度抽樣。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Control remaining thickness separately from subsurface damage. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use thickness maps, edge-chip inspection and sampled strength evidence. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「需要厚度圖、邊緣缺口檢查及強度抽樣」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use thickness maps, edge-chip inspection and sampled strength evidence, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

sources.title: Solutions for Temporary Bonding and Debonding

guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 晶圓薄化與背面研磨：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer thinning and backside grinding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「最終厚度分配」建立判讀邊界。目標厚度須扣除後續應力釋放和露出加工留量。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Final-thickness allocation to define the interpretation boundary. Final thickness must reserve later stress-relief and reveal allowances. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜最終厚度分配：畫厚度預算的逐站瀑布圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜邊緣缺口：保留圓周缺陷圖與搬運方向。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜後段交接：按下站功能分別列接受條件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Final-thickness allocation: Draw a station-by-station thickness waterfall. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Edge chipping: Retain circumferential defect maps and handling directions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Downstream handoff: Define acceptance by the next station's function. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「邊緣缺口」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「後段交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Edge chipping: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Downstream handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：研磨終點就是最終封裝厚度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：中心厚度合格可忽略邊緣裂紋。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating the grinding endpoint with final package thickness. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Ignoring edge cracks after a center-thickness pass. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：薄化幾何、次表面損傷與薄片支撐。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。

related.difference: 暫時接合重在支撐釋放，本課分析材料移除與損傷
related.differenceEn: Temporary bonding emphasizes support/release; this course analyzes removal/damage
practice: 以「最終厚度分配」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「目標厚度須扣除後續應力釋放和露出加工留量。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「畫厚度預算的逐站瀑布圖。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use final-thickness allocation to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Final thickness must reserve later stress-relief and reveal allowances.
Using "Draw a station-by-station thickness waterfall.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.
